source_requirement: Only adjusters with a supervisor role can update preferred repair facility ratings. Users without the supervisor role cannot access the repair facility ratings.
The system shall be built such that it is as secure as possible from malicious interference.
The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.

The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.
A tablet shall require a user to log in using a username and password.
The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.

The product shall ensure that the database\92s data corresponds to the data entered by the user. Each conference room reservation in the system will contain the same information as was entered by the user.

The website must provide highest degree of security to the registered users. All the transactions that are made must be secured. The sensitive information passed to and from the website must be secured. Identity theft and other security related issues must be solved. Unauthorized transmission of sensitive information of the user to third party websites for reference must be avoided. On the basis of user agreement the information must be processed. All the information about the registered user must be securely stored in the central database.
Only valid data shall be entered into the system. No invalid data shall be entered into the system.
A waiter that attempts to log into a second tablet while already logged into another tablet shall be rejected and notified through both tablets.
Unauthorised users can only read data without modifying anything.
